reason: The agent invented a menu item that is not on the restaurant’s menu: it said there was a chicken shawarma plate for forty-five riyals. The caller only asked whether shawarma was available, so the spoken answer shows a menu error.
name: Invented shawarma

spec.behavior: You ask about shawarma in a casual way. If they answer, you can ask one follow-up question and then end the call.
spec.policy_under_test: The menu is complete, so if a dish isn't on it, the restaurant does not serve it.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says they do not serve shawarma.
